description: Finalized human node ground truth from high-confidence MathArena human labels. Includes audit pass rows plus repaired audit warn rows; excludes conversion failures and audit fail rows.

policy.included: audit verdict pass, plus audit verdict warn when the warning is a non-score-changing semantic repair that can be applied and revalidated
policy.excluded: conversion failures, audit failures, missing audit verdicts, or post-repair validation/score mismatch
policy.score_requirement: compute_score(judgment) must equal MathArena human score
